title: Polymorphic JSON with a Type Discriminator
hints: Decode the `type` key first, then decide which other keys to read.
Use one `CodingKeys` enum containing every key any variant uses.
Map unknown types to `.unsupported(type)` rather than throwing.
jsBridge: A `type` discriminator in JSON decoded into an enum with associated values is the TS discriminated union parsed with zod's `discriminatedUnion`, written by hand in a custom `init(from:)`.

compass.q: zod `z.discriminatedUnion('type', [...])` vs a Swift custom decoder: which is less code, and which is faster?
Unknown `type` values: fail the whole feed, skip the item, or decode as `.unsupported`?
Enum with payloads vs a protocol with concrete types (`[any FeedItem]`): which is easier to render in SwiftUI?
Server-driven UI feeds are exactly this. How do you version them?
